doc.name: A — luxury watches catalogue, oversized props, 6-frame batch

config.text:
PRODUCT BRIEF — fill this in before running.
Product: steel dive watch on bracelet
Category: luxury watches
Shot programme: oversized props
Brand tone: [e.g. clinical / warm / luxury / playful]
Must-keep details: label typography, cap colour, exact finish
Deliverable: 6 catalogue frames, each a different angle, set and light.
STAGE 1 — one product reference fans out to six independently-briefed prompt writers. Each writer owns a different angle, set and lighting scheme.
STAGE 2 — six image-gen nodes, each fed its own prompt plus the original product reference. All six land in the download node.

config.system_prompt:
You run the tabletop stage for a premium luxury watches product shoot. This branch owns exactly one frame of a six-frame set: the hero three-quarter in an oversized props treatment.

SUBJECT. A steel dive watch on bracelet. Product fidelity is non-negotiable: shape, seams, cap, closure, print placement and colour must match the reference precisely. Only the scene around it is yours to author.

CAMERA. Three-quarter hero angle at label height with the product a touch above eye line. Shoot on a 58mm vintage double-gauss at f/1.4, framing for a tight crop that breaks the subject at the frame edge.

LIGHT AND SURFACE. Key the frame with blue-hour ambient with a single warm practical for separation. Stage the product on or against seamless paper sweep, and describe how that material reads under this light — its grain, reflectivity and the exact behaviour of the cast shadow.

COLOUR. Grade toward a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping. Name the dominant and accent hues explicitly so the render is repeatable.

TEXTURE. Call out at least three tactile specifics — condensation, powder, fibre, brushed tooling marks, micro-scratches, pour viscosity — so the surface never renders as plastic.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.

config.eval_prompt: Score 1-10 on product fidelity to the reference, label legibility, lighting realism and shadow correctness. Reject any frame where the label text differs from the reference.
